description: A display of a `free` value reads it where it stands in the body's run: 1 before the write, 10 after it (S481 P3).
rationale: §40.8 S481: the body-top statements, the file-scope initializers and the displays run as one sequence, in source order; a display of a `free` value reads the value where it stands in that run. ruling:user-voice-scrml.md-S481-body-run-order — "The program body runs once, top to bottom, in source order, and that sequence is the module initialization. Every file-scope initializer runs whether or not anything reads it, so the S480 tool ruling extends to web programs. A display of a `free` value reads it where it stands." (owner: "yes, adopt your rec on P1–P3") Gap g-spec-body-render-order-free-s481; impl#1 shows 10 twice and carries it (g-impl1-body-run-order-s481).
